rows.en:
But sometimes, finding the slightest gap in our self-control, the evil in our hearts shows itself.
...In the end, I can't blame anyone.
Whatever really happened between Kanda and whoever it was.
It's not my job to pursue it.
If they feel the pangs of a human conscience, then all that's left is for them to atone for their sins themselves.{p}

"Heeey, {a}!"
...Oh, it's Sanae.
Sanae came running toward me, waving.{p}
I looked at my watch.

She was right on time.
Ever since that day, Sanae and I have talked a lot.
I think she's an honest, good girl.
I don't completely believe her stories about the grandma and grandpa who supposedly live inside her, but I'm sure she really does have some strange power.
And meeting her made me able to believe in fate, in something that can't be written off as coincidence.{p}

Whether Sanae and I will really get married someday, I can't know yet; that's still a long way off.
But for now, I want to take good care of her.{p}

...Come to think of it, yesterday I finished the manuscript for the special feature on the school's seven wonders.
I agonized over what to do about the seventh story, but there was no way I could write about what happened in the club room.
So instead, I wrote: 'Something bad happens to whoever hears the seventh story. That is why it cannot be written here.'
If you hear all of a school's seven wonders, something bad will happen...
It seems every school has a rumor like that.
I don't think I'll ever tell anyone about what happened that day...{p}

"Everyone, thank you so much for today.
It's a shame the seventh person never came, but I got to hear some really scary stories, so I think I can write a good article.
It's late, so please be careful on your way home..."
I bowed deeply to everyone.{p}

"Took forever, but hey, it was fun."
That was Shindo.{p}

"See ya."
Shindo was the first to open the club room door.{p}

"You're right.
I really can't keep you all here any longer.
It's late, too.
This uneasy feeling must just be my imagination.
Sorry for all the trouble, everyone.
Please be careful on your way home."
I said it with my head down.
But my bad feeling didn't go away; it only grew stronger and stronger.
In that atmosphere, everyone was starting to get ready to leave.{p}

"See ya."
Shindo was the first to open the club room door.{p}

...Um, who's Sanae?
Is she someone I know?
Have I met her somewhere?
She looks like a student at this school, but there are so many of us.
I'm sure I've seen her at least once.
...I can't remember.
Could she be the seventh one?
Ignoring Fukuzawa, she looked around at each of us in turn, as if sizing us up.
And the moment she looked me in the eye, she froze.{p}

"...Are you {a}?"
How does this girl know who I am?
What is it about her... she has a really mysterious air.
Then she looked at my face and smiled sweetly.{p}

"Ah!"
I cried out without meaning to.
For an instant, I thought something squirmed inside her mouth.
Was it my imagination?
...That's it!
It hit me.
This scene rings a bell.
Yes, she's Sanae Motoki, the girl from Fukuzawa's story.
That's why she gave me such a strange impression.{p}

"...Uh, no."
That's what I found myself answering.
"Why would you lie like that?
I know perfectly well that you're {a}."
Motoki said to me.
Why did I lie?
It's not as if I'd done anything shameful that I'd need to lie to her about.
I apologized to her.
"...Sorry, I didn't mean to lie.
Yes, I'm {b} {a}."
She came closer to me.{p}

"No, that doesn't matter.
But I'm so glad you're alive."{p}

Just then, Arai cut in.
"Why not?
We could wait here forever and get nowhere...
In that case, I think we may as well hear her story.
It makes no difference who tells the seventh story."{p}

He might have a point.
If we unexpectedly get to hear an interesting story out of this, that's a bonus.
But she's a girl with a dangerous air about her. Will it be all right?
Is it really okay to leave the seventh story to someone like that?
Hope and anxiety mingled inside me.{p}

...I can't hurt Motoki in front of everyone.
If I just say this for now, I can always talk my way out of it later.
Motoki gives off a slightly dangerous vibe, but looking at her like this, she's actually pretty cute.
Even if we did end up going out, it might work out pretty well.
For now, I'll let her save face.{p}
"Yeah, all right. If you'll have me."{p}

"Motoki.
I'm sorry, but I want to find my life partner on my own.
I don't know what your grandma told you, but I don't believe in that kind of thing at all."
Honestly, I'd be in real trouble if I got roped into promising marriage over something like this.
Besides, it's not like I don't have a girlfriend.
Marriage isn't something you should bring up so lightly.
"Motoki, you don't have to tell the seventh story anymore, either.
...Come on, everyone, let's go home."
I said it a little angrily.{p}

Motoki hung her head, biting her lip.
Then big tears spilled from her eyes.{p}

Fukuzawa spoke up.
"{a}, you didn't have to make Sanae cry, did you?
That's awful of you.
Sanae, there are plenty of people who could take {a}'s place.
See? So don't cry."{p}

"{a}, go easy on making girls cry, huh?
Well, we're gonna head home ahead of you."{p}

Following Shindo, everyone started getting ready to leave.
"Bye-bye!"
And one by one, they went home.
Three of us were left in the club room: Fukuzawa, me and Motoki.
Fukuzawa was trying her hardest to cheer her up.
Motoki was still crying.
It really is hard to have a girl crying in front of you.
"Hic... sniff, hey, Reiko.
Could you leave the two of us alone? Hic..."
Motoki said through her tears.{p}
"Sure. You two can talk it out as long as you need."{p}

"Wait, ah..."
I tried to stop her, but before I could say a word, she was already out of the club room.{p}

Motoki had stopped crying, but the awkward atmosphere that had been hanging over us since earlier hadn't changed.
"...So I can't get married anymore, can I?"
She gazed at me with teary eyes.
I'm a sucker for this kind of thing.{p}

"It's okay. I don't mind if I can't get married.
I'll try to forget about you.
But... won't you grant my last wish?"
She looked me straight in the eye as she said it.
Straight at me, as if her gaze were piercing my eyes...{p}Should I grant her wish?
Okay
I can't do that

"Okay."
I nodded, as if I'd been hypnotized.
Right after, it hit me.
This girl is pretty weird, isn't she?
She isn't going to ask for something I can't do... is she?{p}

"I'm so happy.
Um, well,
would you kiss me?
I want a nice memory of you, {a}."
Motoki said, looking down.
She was tugging at the hem of my uniform.{p}

...............So that's how she's going to come at me.
Motoki is a pretty cute girl, so I guess it's fine.
When she asks with a face like that, my resolve wavers a little.
It's not like it would be my first kiss, either.
I'll just have to see it as no strings attached and go for it.
I nodded and took her by the shoulders.{p}
She closed her eyes, ready to receive me.{p}

And then I kissed her small lips.
I felt as if her pulse and mine had become one.{p}

"..........★"
I sensed something nasty and tried to pull away from her.
But she had her arms wrapped around me with incredible strength, so I couldn't get away.
Or rather, my lips wouldn't come away from hers.
And then something unidentifiable started pushing its way from her mouth into mine.
My mouth filled up with that unidentifiable thing.
I couldn't hold it in any longer...
"Gulp..."
I ended up swallowing it.
Motoki finally pulled away from me.{p}

Her tearful face had changed completely into a beaming smile.
"Hey, {a}.
I guess I can't forget about you after all.
...I just can't forget about you.
So I made you the same as me.
...I shared the grandpa and grandma inside me with you, {a}.
So now we can never be separated.
...No matter what happens.
And so, from now on, I'd love to get to know you much better, {a}, is what I'm thinking..."{p}

...This is horrible. What has she done to me!
Am I going to have the spirits of Motoki's grandpa and grandma living inside my body for the rest of my life★
I can't stand something that gross.
"Oh, look!
Just now, Grandma peeked out of your mouth, {a}.
Look, look, she's waving. Tee hee!"
Motoki was waving back toward my mouth.
How can this be happening...{p}

I heard footsteps from outside the club room.
Could that be the seventh one?
The one coming to kill everyone here...
Was Motoki's story true?{p}

"...I see, so you won't grant my last wish.
Okay. Goodbye☆"{p}

With that, Motoki left the club room.
I could hear her running down the hallway.
Isn't Motoki just one of those emotionally unstable girls who get carried away by their own fantasies?
That stuff about the seventh one coming to kill us must be a lie too.
I definitely never want to get caught by a girl like that.{p}

Then I looked around the club room.
The empty club room...
I had meant to leave the club room together with everyone.
But her sudden intrusion had made that impossible.
Frankly, the school building at night is scary.
I have to go home by myself.
Suddenly, I felt a chill.
No, I absolutely won't think about scary things here.
I know that once I start, the scary thoughts will spread through me and won't go away.{p}

Come to think of it, they say telling scary stories draws spirits. Is that true?
Oh no!
Right after I told myself not to think about it...
If spirits really do gather, then this place must be full of them.{p}

...No, that's just superstition.
But maybe, right now, there's a spirit behind me.
Maybe it's resting its chin on my shoulder, laughing.
See, if I turn around like this...{p}

"AAAAAAAAAAH☆"
I screamed.{p}

"WAAAAAAAAH☆
Don't scare me like that!
You startled me, you idiot.
I thought my heart was gonna stop!"
Huh?
H-Hino?
All the strength drained out of my body.{p}

"Huh, looks like everyone went home after all.
Man, I couldn't find anybody to tell the seventh story.
And here I rushed through my errands so I could tell the seventh story myself...
Oh well, can't be helped."
Hino, you being behind me without my noticing was scarier than any of the stories...{p}

"Well, no point hanging around here forever. Let's go home!
Oh, I know, let's grab something to eat at a diner.
I'm starving."
Hino grabbed my bag and started to head off ahead of me.
"Ah, wait for me☆"
I'm lucky to have such a good senior...{p}

"I don't think it was murder.
I think it was suicide after all.
I think he got tired of the relationships around him.
Things were all ugly and tangled.
Maybe he just suddenly wanted to escape from reality.
If it was suicide, though, I think he acted too hastily."
When I answered, Motoki stared at me with an unconvinced look.{p}

"I see.
So that's what you think, {a}.
But you know, people don't commit suicide for no reason.
There's always a cause, right?
And that cause is almost always something like relationships, isn't it?
I think that's basically murder, just without doing it with your own hands.{p}

So Kanda's death was a kind of murder too, one that goes by the name of suicide.
I think he was murdered.
Oh, don't mind me... it doesn't really mean anything.
Even my grandma won't tell me why he died.
But you know, the seventh one will be here soon.
Who do you think the seventh one is?{p}

...That's right, it's Kanda.
Kanda is coming."{p}

Shindo looked a little uncomfortable.
"...Well, sure, it's not like I didn't know him.
He was in my class.
But I only knew him a little.
If it's Kanda you wanna know about, wouldn't Iwashita know more than me?
There was a rumor Iwashita was going out with Kanda."{p}

Huh?
Startled, I turned my eyes to Iwashita.
Iwashita was smiling, her head still bowed.
"...Well, who knows.
Shindo, I don't think you should believe people's rumors so easily.
Did you see it?
Did you see something going on between me and Kanda?
If you haven't seen anything, you'd better not spread strange rumors, for your own good.
I despise liars, you see.
If I really had been going out with a man named Kanda, I'm sure I would have wanted to kill him.{p}

...More to the point, it was Fukuzawa, wasn't it?
I hear you secretly had feelings for Kanda.
And I heard that Kanda had recently started going out with a new girl.
Though, of course, that's nothing more than a rumor either.
I believe her name was Reiko Fukuzawa..."{p}

"What are you talking about?!"
Cutting Iwashita off, Fukuzawa slammed her hand down on the desk.
"Just because you're my senior doesn't mean you can say whatever you like!
Are you saying Kanda killed himself because of me?
Sure, I admit I liked Kanda.
But there had to be some other reason.
Are you saying I was the reason?
I was the one who was saddest when he died!
Saying something like that... I know the truth!
Trying to pin your own crime on somebody else, you're unbelievable!
Kanda didn't kill himself.
You killed him!"{p}

"I think the girl who was secretly in love with Kanda killed him.
She probably got into an argument with him over whether or not he'd break up with his jealous girlfriend, right?
Kanda wanted to break up with his jealous girlfriend, but that's exactly why he was scared to...
He must have figured that if he brought up breaking up, it wouldn't end well.
Watching him like that, she flew into a rage and killed him, don't you think?"
When I answered, Motoki nodded to herself over and over.{p}

"I see.
So that's what you think, {a}.
...Oh, it doesn't really mean anything.
Even my grandma won't tell me who killed him.
Maybe she really doesn't know.
But you know, the seventh one will be here soon.
Who do you think the seventh one is?
...That's right, it's Kanda.
Kanda is coming."{p}

Shindo looked a little uncomfortable.
"...Well, sure, it's not like I didn't know him.
He was in my class.
But I only knew him a little.
If it's Kanda you wanna know about, wouldn't Iwashita know more than me?
There was a rumor Iwashita was going out with Kanda."{p}

What?
Startled, I turned my eyes to Iwashita. Iwashita was smiling, her head still bowed.
"...Well, who knows.
Shindo, I don't think you should be so quick to believe people's rumors either.
Did you see it?
Did you see something going on between me and Kanda?
You didn't even see anything, so for your own good, you'd better not start strange rumors.
I can't stand liars, you see.
If I really had been going out with a man named Kanda, I'm sure I would have wanted to kill him.{p}

...More to the point, it was Fukuzawa, wasn't it?
I hear you secretly had feelings for Kanda.
And I heard that Kanda had recently started going out with a new girl.
Though, of course, that's nothing more than a rumor either.
I believe her name was Reiko Fukuzawa..."{p}

"What are you talking about?!"
Cutting Iwashita off, Fukuzawa slammed her hand down on the desk.
"Senior or not, there are things you just don't say!
Are you saying I killed Kanda?
Sure, I'll admit I liked him.
But why would I have to kill him?
When he died, I was the one who grieved the most!
I know the truth!
It was you!
You killed him!"{p}

I had been pretty surprised when it came up that Iwashita was going out with Kanda.
But to think Fukuzawa was the girl who had secretly loved Kanda...
If Iwashita was right, I had practically said that Fukuzawa killed Kanda.
After an argument with Kanda...
And on top of that, I had even called Iwashita the jealous type who might do anything.
Luckily, the two of them seemed to have completely forgotten what I'd said.
Fukuzawa was glaring at Iwashita with a ferocious look on her face.{p}

"I think it was a guy who had a one-sided crush on that girl.
I bet he really hated Kanda.
Kanda had a girlfriend and was still going out with other girls, and if one of them was the girl that guy was pining for...
I think he'd convinced himself that once Kanda was out of the way, she'd naturally be his.
He might turn out to be a pretty dangerous guy."{p}

When I answered, Motoki nodded to herself over and over.
"I see.
So that's what you think, {a}.
...Oh, it doesn't mean anything in particular.
My grandma won't tell me who killed him either.
Maybe she really doesn't know.
But you know, the seventh one is coming soon.
Who do you think the seventh one is?
...That's right, it's Kanda.
Kanda is coming."{p}

Shindo looked a little uncomfortable.
"...Well, sure, it's not like I didn't know him.
He was in my class.
But I only knew him a little.
If it's Kanda you wanna know about, wouldn't Iwashita know more than me?
There was a rumor Iwashita was going out with Kanda."{p}

What?
Startled, I turned my eyes to Iwashita. Iwashita was smiling, her head still bowed.
"...Well, who knows.
Shindo, I don't think you should be so quick to believe people's rumors either.
Did you see it?
Did you see something going on between me and Kanda?
You didn't even see anything, so for your own good, you'd better not start strange rumors.
I can't stand liars, you see.
If I really had been going out with a man named Kanda, I'm sure I would have wanted to kill him.{p}

...More to the point, it was Fukuzawa, wasn't it?
I hear you secretly had feelings for Kanda.
And I heard that Kanda had recently started going out with a new girl.
Though, of course, that's nothing more than a rumor either.
I believe her name was Reiko Fukuzawa..."{p}

"What are you saying?!"
Cutting Iwashita off, Fukuzawa pounded hard on the desk.
"You may be my senior, but there are things you just don't say!
Are you saying I killed Kanda?
Sure, I admit I liked Kanda.
But why would I have to kill him?
I was the one who was saddest when he died!
I know the truth!
It was you!
You killed him!"
I was simply dumbfounded.
Fukuzawa was glaring daggers at Iwashita with a ferocious look on her face.
But Iwashita, on the receiving end, wasn't backing down either.{p}

"...Proof?
If you say I killed him, then go on, show me the proof.
Say one careless word, and I wouldn't mind killing you."
The two of them kept glaring at each other.
I had no idea what to do.{p}

It was Hosoda who stepped in between them.
"Now, now, please don't get so angry, you two.
Everyone, let's stop imagining weird things.
Whoever killed him, it has nothing to do with us here, right?
What good is arguing about that going to do?
Let's all get along, okay?"
The two of them didn't listen to a word Hosoda said.
They kept glaring at each other in silence.
Just then, Arai cleared his throat.{p}

"Ahem.
I don't know much about that story, but it sounds rather complicated.
...Hosoda, you like Fukuzawa, don't you?
That's only a guess, of course.
Ever since you got here, you've been sneaking glances at Fukuzawa, haven't you?
Is there something going on?"
Arai looked at Hosoda with probing eyes.{p}

"Ahahaha, guess I've been found out, huh?
Truth is, ever since I thought, 'Hey, a girl just my type has joined the first-years,' I've been watching Fukuzawa the whole time.
Though it's one-sided, of course...
I never dreamed I'd get to sit here and talk with her like this today.
Oh man, this is embarrassing."{p}

rows.en:
Hosoda bent his big body over, stifling his laughter.
Yikes☆
Thank goodness Hosoda was so giddy over the current topic.
Whew, that was close...
I'd said something weird in answer to Motoki's question earlier.
I'd as good as called Hosoda a pervert obsessed with her, and a dangerous one at that.
Please, please don't let Hosoda remember what I said earlier.{p}

"Or maybe he got caught up in some kind of accident and was killed, and it was made to look like a suicide.
...No, that's not it.
Maybe there was someone else involved with Kanda besides the people Motoki mentioned earlier.
Someone else who hated Kanda enough to want him dead..."
When I answered, Motoki nodded to herself over and over.{p}

"I see.
So that's what you think, {a}.
...Oh, it doesn't really mean anything.
Even my grandma won't tell me who killed him.
Maybe she really doesn't know.
But you know, the seventh one will be here soon.
Who do you think the seventh one is?
...That's right, it's Kanda.
Kanda is coming."{p}

"I just can't believe that, no matter what.
It's crazy to expect anyone to believe a story this out there.
I can barely keep up with where this is going as it is."
I said it with a troubled look.
Seeing me like that, Motoki gave me a sweet smile and said:{p}

"Yeah, I know.
You really are a normal person, aren't you, {a}?
...Funny, me of all people saying that, huh.
You know, I think I could come to like you even more, {a}, just the way you are."
When she said that, I felt like the amount of blood my heart was pumping out had gone up a little.{p}

"Let's rethink this marriage thing after all.
There's something wrong with you.
I'm still young. I don't want to go out with a girl like you, and I don't want to think about marriage."
I'd finally gone and said it.
I considered myself a perfectly ordinary person.
There was no way someone like me could go out with Motoki and make it work.
I was sure she'd keep jerking me around.
When I thought about that, I just couldn't keep from saying it.
I glanced at Motoki.
She was looking down, biting her lip hard.
And then...
Motoki ran over to the door.
Then she looked at me and said:{p}

"Fine.
Fine, then.
Everyone avoids me like that, don't they?
Even you, {a}... You promised me, didn't you?
That you'd marry me...
Was that a lie★"{p}She asked me.
It wasn't a lie!
It was a lie...

Big tears were spilling down Motoki's cheeks.
I regretted what I had done.
This went beyond whether we'd get married or not.
Motoki might be strange, but she was still an ordinary girl after all...
When I thought that, she looked unbearably dear to me.{p}

"I'm sorry for saying that earlier.
It's just that, with things the way they are, I ended up saying it.
I'm sorry.
Is that promise from earlier still good?"
I'd come out with a line so slick that it surprised even me a little.
And I meant it, from the bottom of my heart.{p}
Motoki wiped away her tears and smiled at me.

"Thank you.
I thought you hated me after all, and the tears just came pouring out...
But I'm so glad.
That it wasn't how you really felt, {a}..."{p}

"It's Kanda...
The knocking earlier was him too.
It seems he's been waiting this whole time for someone to open the door.
He can't come in on his own..."
With that, she flung the door open.{p}

...A man was standing there.
He was probably Kanda.
I say 'probably' partly because I didn't know Kanda, but before that, he had nothing above the neck.
A man in a school uniform, with no head, was standing there.
At his sudden appearance, everyone froze stiff.
It seemed no one could even speak.{p}
Just then, Motoki's body began to shake and jerk violently.{p}
But her laughter gradually faded away.{p}

"Words are cheap.
I knew back then that you didn't really mean it.
How dare you trample all over my feelings."
With that, she flung the door open.{p}

...A man was standing there.
He was probably Kanda.
I say 'probably' partly because I didn't know Kanda, but before that, it was because he had nothing above the neck.
A man in a school uniform, with no head, was standing there.
At the sudden turn of events, everyone was at a loss for words.
Motoki spoke.{p}

"Grandma just told me.
If we offer one of the people here to him as a sacrifice, everyone else can be saved."
A murmur ran through everyone.
"But don't worry, everyone.
I'll decide...
Hey, {a}, how about you?
Hee hee hee."{p}

W-why me★
I'm the one person here with the least to do with Kanda!
Why?!
Is she still holding a grudge over what happened earlier after all?
Then the man who seemed to be Kanda began to walk with robot-like movements.
He had no head, yet he was walking straight toward me.
I had to run!
M-my body won't move★
...Everyone was holding me down.
Gripping my legs, my arms, my head tight...{p}

"It's best if you're the one who gets sacrificed.
I figure it's cleanest if somebody with no connection to Kanda is the sacrifice.
I feel bad about it, but we're counting on you here."
Hey, come on, that's just not right!
I screamed with all my might.
"Motoki☆"{p}

I definitely saw them.
The spirits said to live in Motoki's body, swaying and flickering all around her...{p}

...Every one of them seemed like the culprit.
...But there was no solid proof.
I had to pick one victim from among them.
Either way, if I didn't name someone here, everyone might be killed.
And so, I decided.{p}
...Iwashita.{p}

She had said it herself: if you want to kill me, go ahead and kill me.
She'd just have to get exactly what she said.
That's what she got for saying something like that so lightly.
I was trying to justify to myself the fact that I had chosen her.{p}

(It's Akemi Iwashita...)
I murmured inside my head.
(...Understood.)
A voice that seemed to be an answer echoed in my head.{p}

Then the one who must have been Kanda began walking stiffly, like a robot.
His footsteps went pat... pat... as he walked around all of us.
Everyone had their eyes shut and their fists clenched tight.
I could almost hear everyone screaming, 'Don't stop behind me!'
...Was he really going to kill the person I named?
Kanda went on walking for a while.
It was amazing he could walk so well without a head.
Could he sense his way?
Either way, he wasn't of this world anymore.
Then he stopped dead behind Iwashita.
J-just as I thought.
It was true.{p}
At that moment, the lights suddenly went out.

At the same time, I heard a horrible scream and a sound like something being snapped apart.
Something happening in the dark is never a good thing.
Something was definitely happening, yet I couldn't even move.
Then, before long, the lights came back on.{p}

"Eek☆"
We let out strangled screams.
There lay Iwashita's corpse, sprawled on the floor, her head ripped off.
Blood was still spurting from the arteries of her torn neck.
Her body even seemed to still be twitching.
And then we froze.{p}

Kanda was standing in the doorway of the club room.
Yes, wearing Iwashita's ripped-off head...
(I've got my head now.
Anyone would have done.
But what luck that it turned out to be the one who killed me.
Now I can finally be at peace.)
Kanda was looking my way with Iwashita's face.
Then he turned around, his back to us.
Kanda now looked like a long-haired student in a school uniform.
He disappeared down the hallway just like that.{p}

Had I really been right to name her?
But Kanda had said it.
That she was the one who had killed him...
But if I had named someone else, I would have...
I shuddered.
When I looked over, I saw that Motoki was crying.{p}

"I wasn't going to let anyone die!
That's why I came here!
Grandma didn't help me when it really mattered..."
It had ended up this way in the first place because I chose Iwashita.
"Motoki, none of this is your fault.
If anything, you were trying to save us."
I comforted Motoki.
When really, I was the one who wanted to cry most.{p}

At that moment.
Motoki, who had been holding my hand, began to shake and jerk violently.
"Motoki!"
I shouted without thinking, but she didn't respond.
She was unconscious, as if someone had taken her over.{p}

Suddenly, something like white smoke came out of her mouth.
The haze vanished as if it had been sucked into Iwashita's corpse.
In that instant, the headless Iwashita twitched.
Then she stood bolt upright.{p}

Unable to move, we could only watch what she did.
Walking stiffly, she went out into the hallway, then ran off at tremendous speed.
A headless corpse racing through the school building at night...
Silence fell for a while.
Motoki said quietly,
"That was Grandpa disposing of the body for us.
So we wouldn't get into trouble."
It was all over.{p}

We agreed that what had happened here would be everyone's secret.
Well, even without that promise, none of us would ever tell anyone.
Telling wouldn't change anything.
After all, whoever told would be the one suspected...
Before long, I heard that Iwashita had been found on the embankment near the school.
In the end, the case was closed as the work of some deranged pervert.
It was too great a shock for high schoolers like us.{p}
...And then came the after-school hours exactly one week after that horrible incident.{p}

...Every one of them seemed like the culprit.
...But there was no solid proof.
I had to pick one victim from among them.
Either way, if I didn't name someone here, everyone might be killed.
And so, I decided.{p}

...Kazama.
That's right, out of everyone here, it could only be him.
He was perfect for the part.
A flake like him doesn't need to exist in this world.
That's what I told myself.
...It was a bit of a stretch.
Because the truth was, I didn't want to sacrifice anyone, no matter who they were.
But weigh six lives against one, and it's obvious which is heavier.{p}

(...It's Kazama.)
I murmured in my heart.
(Good... understood...)
Kanda's voice echoed in my head.{p}

Then the one who must have been Kanda began walking stiffly, like a robot.
He walked over to Kazama and stopped dead.{p}

"Wh-why are you coming to me?!
There's somebody else you oughta have a grudge against!"
Kazama probably thought he was standing his ground, but to anyone watching, he was clearly ready to bolt.
Kanda reached his hands out toward Kazama.
We couldn't stop Kanda; all we could do was cower where we stood.{p}

At that moment.
Motoki, who had been holding my hand, began to shake and jerk violently.
"Motoki!"
I shouted without thinking, but she didn't respond.
She was unconscious, as if someone had taken her over.{p}

Suddenly, something like white smoke came out of her mouth.
In the smoke, the face of a woman with a truly terrifying expression appeared.
The instant it appeared, it lunged at Kanda.
"Yes!"
I cried.
That had to be the grandma who lived inside Motoki.
She must have come out to help us.{p}

Then a spirit's scream roared through the club room.
The haze that had come out of Motoki slithered back into her mouth.{p}

...What happened?!
Why did Motoki's grandma go back inside her?
Kanda's scream echoed in my head.
(I won't lose to the likes of this!
How dare you try to get in my way.
If it's come to this, I'm taking you all down with me!)
...This is bad. At this rate, everyone's in danger!
Motoki had passed out too.
This was what they meant by the worst possible situation.
I was sure of it...{p}

"Kanda...
You're trying to kill me?
Then kill whoever drove you to your death.
If you won't listen to reason, I've got ideas of my own.
Don't take me lightly just 'cause I've been playing nice."
With that, Kazama rose briskly to his feet.
He seemed like a different person from before.
I found myself shouting.{p}

"Kazama, no!
Nothing you say to him here will do any good!"
Kazama looked at me and gave me a wink.
K-Kazama, this is no time to be acting all cool!
Of all things, Kazama had put both his hands on Kanda's shoulders.
Kanda had his hands on Kazama's neck.
Was he going to take Kazama's head?{p}

At that moment, a dazzling light enveloped us.
I couldn't tell where the light was coming from.
It was so bright we couldn't keep our eyes open.
Then, through my eyelids, I could tell the light was gradually fading.{p}

...He was standing right there.
...And his head was still on!
We were saved.
"That guy was trying to kill me, you know.
If he wanted to kill somebody, he should've gone after whoever killed him.
Trying to kill me is barking up the wrong tree. Honestly.
Sure, I teased him, but I never did anything to deserve getting killed.
If I got killed over that, I'd never rest in peace.
Man, I had to use powers I didn't even need to use, here of all places."{p}
